summaryZh: Hangauer 实验室研究细胞如何在长期细胞毒性应激下存活、发生适应并影响健康与疾病。团队也研究某些细胞为何更易发生铁死亡和铜死亡等非凋亡死亡；页面未明确具体方法。
researchQuestions: 细胞如何在长期细胞毒性应激下存活并产生适应，这些变化如何影响健康与疾病？
为何某些细胞对铁死亡和铜死亡等非凋亡死亡通路更敏感？

evidence.quote: The Hangauer lab focuses on understanding the fundamental mechanisms of cell survival of cytotoxic stress. We seek to discover how cells survive prolonged exposure to various physiological forms of cytotoxic stress, the adaptations which occur as a result of this, and how this affects human health and disease. We also seek to understand why certain cells are sensitized to nonapoptotic death pathways including ferroptosis and cuproptosis.
Assistant Professor Department of Dermatology UC San Diego
